features.requirement: Independent left and right handles, straight/up/down × short/long = twelve profile slots
features.verification: 52 host gesture assertions pass, including all 12 mirrored mappings, quick-action combinations, cancellation, release and timer state.

features.requirement: Radial long distance plus timer from DOWN for while-held quick action; long-classified release dispatches immediately; no duplicate short action
Separate short/long quick action settings
features.note: Independent quick_short=false and quick_long=true defaults; immediate short firing suppresses any long action in that same gesture. Legacy long_immediate controls zero-delay long dispatch only.

features.requirement: Configurable short/long angle boundaries, not fixed45-degree classification
features.note: Independent short/long upper and lower inner (5-70 degrees) and outer (75-85 degrees) boundaries now drive recognition and dispatch. Existing symmetric direction_angle_degrees and 80-degree outer fallback remain until each new boundary is configured. Separate short/long valid regions and disabled-long behavior have JVM regression coverage; see docs/oho-haptics-angles.md.
features.remaining: Native graphical editor now uses independent draggable boundaries with float precision, fixed direction guides, integer display and mirrored viewing. Near-vertical motion remains non-actionable rather than adding original vertical-scroll actions; Android touch/rendering regression tracked separately.

features.requirement: Independent quick feedback timing, system feedback and custom vibration level
features.note: Quick vibration defaults on and latches the first short threshold; disabling it retains action-time feedback. Separate custom mode defaults to system GESTURE_END feedback; custom duration 0-30ms follows the capable-device OHO implementation, with 0 silent. Stored legacy 1-255 amplitudes remain active until edited. Legacy master-off is represented as visible custom level zero. JVM timing/migration tests passed; physical ColorOS effect is not claimed identical to Samsung.

system_shortcuts.transport: Own APK helper drops Root UID0 to system UID1000 and calls ILauncherApps as android; no launcher impersonation, default-home modification, pin mutation, or serialized-Intent substitution. SDK37 leading IBinder startShortcut variant and older 7-argument variant supported.

One own-helper list-all query for the current user replaces per-app Root processes; disabled entries remain visible but unselectable. Existing window show APIs reuse the same grouped list. 44 catalog/protocol host assertions passed; this new grouped flow awaits separate device regression. See docs/shortcut-grouped-page.md.

task_preview.source: SDK37 ITaskSnapshotManager.getTaskSnapshot(taskId,latestCaptureTime,resolution), low-resolution existing cache. Older IActivityTaskManager getTaskSnapshot fallback uses takeSnapshotIfNeeded=false.
task_preview.privacy: Does not call takeTaskSnapshot or secure capture. Rejects protected buffers and non-real theme placeholders. App does not persist screenshots; Bitmap and HardwareBuffer resources released, process/result cancelled when panel closes or refreshes.
task_preview.verification: verification/task-preview-validation.json: five recent tasks returned145x320 preview images, metadata only persisted. No phone UI automation/capture was run for this read-only probe.
